fast.description: Keyless engines that reliably answer queries: googlecse, yahoo, duckduckgo, seznam, aol

web.description: Every general web-search engine (best-effort ones included)

keyless.description: Every source that needs no API key

code.description: Code search - URLs and endpoints hardcoded in public repositories

intel.description: Source-code markup search and leak/paste corpora (both need keys)

browser.description: Headless browser - Mojeek's ALTCHA, Ecosia's Turnstile, Swisscows' SPA, So.com's real click, Dogpile's WAF, SearXNG's Anubis PoW (needs requirements-browser.txt)

tor.description: Tor hidden-service indexes - onionsearch and tor66web are clearnet, the rest need a running Tor daemon (see --tor-proxy)

full.description: Every registered source, keyed or not
